ci_supplychain_ack.statement: Operator decision 2026-10-08 (supersedes the dormant posture of 2026-05-22): Dependabot version updates go live for the github-actions ecosystem only (weekly, minor/patch grouped, majors separate, 7-day cooldown); all 13 pip ecosystems stay dormant; GitHub-owned actions stay on mutable tags and third-party stay SHA-pinned (unchanged). The wholesale Semgrep exclusion dependabot-missing-cooldown and its register entry are removed because every entry now carries a cooldown.
